verdict.rationale: Square documents that its Terminal API connects a POS application to a Square Terminal, and that the Square Point of Sale app processes in-person payments on Square hardware. That shows the product supports hardware tied to its POS for taking payments. However, nothing describes the merchant-side pairing or registration flow, or how long setup takes. Tap to Pay on iPhone needs no reader, so it is adjacent to this story and not credited. Missing for 10: documented reader pairing or device-registration steps, evidence of setup-to-first-payment in minutes, a merchant-facing (non-API) pairing flow, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can pair a card reader with the POS app or register it to my account and take a payment within minutes

citations.quote: Use the Terminal API to connect a custom POS application with a Square Terminal.
open the Square Point of Sale application and process in-person payments using Square hardware
